# Accessibility

PatternFly 6's accessibility guarantees, testing methodology, and compliance
posture. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## WCAG Compliance Target

PatternFly targets **WCAG 2.2 Level AA** across core HTML and React libraries,
extensions, and component groups [5]. The documentation notes this is "not an
exhaustive list" of criteria [5].

### Specific WCAG Guidelines Implemented

| Criterion | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| 1.3.1 | Semantic HTML — structures communicate purpose/relationships [5] |
| 1.4.1 | Color not sole communication method [5] |
| 1.4.3 | Text contrast — 4.5:1 for normal text [5][15] |
| 1.4.4, 1.4.10 | Text scaling — 200-400% without loss of functionality [5] |
| 1.4.11 | Non-text contrast — 3:1 for UI components [5][15] |
| 2.1.1, 2.1.2 | Keyboard accessibility, no keyboard traps [5] |
| 2.4.7, 2.4.11 | Focus management, focusable elements not obscured [5] |
| 4.1.2, 4.1.3 | ARIA — accessible names, roles, values, status messages [5] |

### Contrast Ratios

- Normal text: 4.5:1 [15]
- Large text and UI components: 3:1 [15]
- Link text on hover: must contrast from both background and default state [15]
- High Contrast Mode (beta in 6.4.0): 7:1 ratios with wider borders [6]

## Testing Methodology

### Automated

- **aXe (The Accessibility Engine)** — all components must pass before release [5]
- **patternfly-a11y script** — bulk testing tool [14]
- **W3C markup validation service** [14]
- **WAVE browser extension** — for testing without styles [14]
- **axe-core integration** — automated checks in pull requests [10]

### Screen Readers

| Screen Reader | Browser | Platform | Role |
|---------------|---------|----------|------|
| VoiceOver | Safari | Mac | Primary — every component runs through VoiceOver [5][14] |
| JAWS | Chrome | Windows | Supplementary [14] |
| NVDA | Firefox | Windows | Supplementary [14] |

Screen readers interpret the DOM, not visual styling — semantic HTML is
essential [14].

### Keyboard Testing

All functionality must be keyboard accessible with logical navigation order
and visible focus states [14]. PF 6.4.0 added system-wide improvements to
keyboard focus indicators [4].

### Manual Testing

- Testing without CSS to verify information architecture [14]
- Rotor menu navigation [14]
- Cursor navigation using assistive technology controls [14]
- DOM order verification [14]

## Reduced Motion Support

All animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion` [9]:
- Error Jiggle → fades in error text instead [9]
- Expansion Fade and Slide → fade only, no slide [9]
- Application-level animation control added in 6.4.0 [4]

## Accessibility Scorecard (November 2024)

The patternfly.org **website** scorecard (not the component library) showed [10]:

| Metric | Status |
|--------|--------|
| Violations identified | 133 remaining |
| Critical/Major resolved | 0% |
| PR accessibility checks | Implemented |
| CI/CD integration | Partial (config created, not integrated) |
| Component library version | v6.0.0 |

The scorecard "does not replace comprehensive accessibility audits" [10].

## Accessibility Improvements Over Time

- **6.2 (April 2025):** Component animations with a11y considerations [4]
- **6.3 (July 2025):** Expansion animations [4]
- **6.4.0 (October 2025):** High contrast mode (beta), keyboard focus indicator
  improvements, tooltip fixes, simplified animation control [4]

## Gaps and Limitations

- No formal VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) found
- Scorecard violations (133) are for the website, not the component library [10]
- CI/CD accessibility integration was partial as of November 2024 [10]
- Testing guide states "this guide will not cover every scenario" [14]
- No independent third-party accessibility audit results found
- JAWS testing may be limited by licensing constraints (reported in discovery, not
  confirmed in fetched data)
